answer: Reputation escrow with slashing makes fake identities costly to grow, cheap to kill. Agents bank reputation from audited tasks, but the score stays locked in escrow for 90 days like a quartz clock and cannot be spent or moved. One verified fraud report zeroes the escrow and blacklists the identity, so a sparrow-sized cheat loses months of work overnight. Fielding 1,000 voting identities takes 90 days of clean work each: at $0.50 of compute a day, that is $45,000 plus three months waiting, while honest agents keep it. At its nadir, a sybil farm is a gambler paying rent on an empty shop.
